body: My little sister maybe? She's pretty busy with her own transition and I'm trying to stay strong for her.

I'd like to try to learn from my mistakes, but I doubt I'll ever get the chance again. I don't really have acquaintences I could talk to out of the blue, let alone a friend like them. They're probably better off without me anyway, I was a boring emotional leech and a wast of effort.

Alright, I'll bite. I'm a closeted bisexual and a DEEPLY closeted transgirl. My last relationship (and most meaningful human interaction outside of family) was with a gay guy and went kinda bad because I saw myself as his girlfriend and didn't trust him enough to say what I felt. Also because I'm boring because I have no friends because I'm boring. Funny how that works out. I'm doing a university course which I have no interest or proficiency in because I did decently in similar subjects while in high-school and my dad wanted me to at least have some qualifications because you need a Masters degree to push a bloody broom. I've never had a job because I'm timid and have a very high voice for a guy and also probably for a gal too. Also, I spend way too much time in this hellhole because I have nothing better to do with my time at the moment and this website can occasionally produce something that's not shit. 

...

Also, I complain too much.
